actionConfiguration.body:
UPDATE nabory
SET
  nr_naboru = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ InputNrNaboru.value || "" }}', ''),
    nr_naboru
  ),

  typ_naboru = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ SelectTypNaboru.value || "" }}', ''),
    typ_naboru
  ),

  opiekun1 = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ SelectOpiekun1.value || "" }}', ''),
    opiekun1
  ),

  opiekun2 = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ SelectOpiekun2.value || "" }}', ''),
    opiekun2
  ),

  data_naboru = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ PickerDateNabor.selectedDate ? moment(PickerDateNabor.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : "" }}', '')::date,
    data_naboru
  ),

  ile_zlozonych = COALESCE(
    {{
      InputIleZlozonych.value === undefined ||
      InputIleZlozonych.value === null ||
      InputIleZlozonych.value === ""
        ? null
        : Number(InputIleZlozonych.value)
    }},
    ile_zlozonych
  ),

  data_przekazania = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ DatePickerPrzekazanie.selectedDate ? moment(DatePickerPrzekazanie.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : "" }}', '')::date,
    data_przekazania
  ),

  ile_przekazanych = COALESCE(
    {{
      InputIlePrzekazanych.value === undefined ||
      InputIlePrzekazanych.value === null ||
      InputIlePrzekazanych.value === ""
        ? null
        : Number(InputIlePrzekazanych.value)
    }},
    ile_przekazanych
  ),

  data_oceny = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ DatePickerOcena.selectedDate ? moment(DatePickerOcena.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : "" }}', '')::date,
    data_oceny
  ),

  data_protokolu = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ DatePickerProtokol.selectedDate ? moment(DatePickerProtokol.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : "" }}', '')::date,
    data_protokolu
  ),

  nr_uchwaly = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ InputNrUchwaly.value || "" }}', ''),
    nr_uchwaly
  ),

  data_uchwaly = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ DatePickerUchwala.selectedDate ? moment(DatePickerUchwala.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : "" }}', '')::date,
    data_uchwaly
  ),

  rezerwa = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ SelectRezerwa.value || "" }}', ''),
    rezerwa
  ),

  uwagi = COALESCE(
    NULLIF(
      '{{ (InputUwagi.value !== undefined && InputUwagi.value !== null ? InputUwagi.value : "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
      ''
    ),
    uwagi
  ),

  typ_projektu = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ InputTypProjektu.value || "" }}', ''),
    typ_projektu
  ),

  status = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ SelectStatus.value || "" }}', ''),
    status
  ),

  budzet_panstwa = COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ SelectBudzet.value || "" }}', ''),
    budzet_panstwa
  ),

  stawka_panel = COALESCE(
    {{
      CurrencyPanel.value === undefined ||
      CurrencyPanel.value === null ||
      CurrencyPanel.value === ""
        ? null
        : Number(CurrencyPanel.value)
    }},
    stawka_panel
  ),

  stawka_fin = COALESCE(
    {{
      CurrencyFinans.value === undefined ||
      CurrencyFinans.value === null ||
      CurrencyFinans.value === ""
        ? null
        : Number(CurrencyFinans.value)
    }},
    stawka_fin
  ),

  stawka_omw = COALESCE(
    {{
      CurrencyOMW.value === undefined ||
      CurrencyOMW.value === null ||
      CurrencyOMW.value === ""
        ? null
        : Number(CurrencyOMW.value)
    }},
    stawka_omw
  ),

  stawka_om = COALESCE(
    {{
      CurrencyOM.value === undefined ||
      CurrencyOM.value === null ||
      CurrencyOM.value === ""
        ? null
        : Number(CurrencyOM.value)
    }},
    stawka_om
  )

WHERE id = {{
  TableNabory.selectedRow && TableNabory.selectedRow.id
    ? TableNabory.selectedRow.id
    : 0
}}

RETURNING
  id,
  nr_naboru,
  data_naboru,
  data_przekazania,
  data_oceny,
  data_protokolu,
  data_uchwaly;
